dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, are you free on Thursday?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ər juː ˈfriː ɑːn ˈθɜːrzdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'm busy. But I'm free on Friday.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, aɪm ˈbɪzi. bʌt aɪm ˈfriː ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! Let's go to the mall on Friday after class.
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ tə ðə ˈmɔːl ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈæftər ˈklæs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At the station, at four o'clock.
dialogue.reading: ət ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ət ˈfɔːr əˈklɑːk.
